card.name: Quantity amounts in size or capacity statements
card.fires_on: Numbers, units and quantity words in statements about how much something holds, delivers or grows by, such as 'up to 160 units' or 'more than 20 percent'.

modes.label: Digits in large counts
modes.description: A digit inside a large number or percentage describing growth or amount.

modes.label: Comparative quantity words
modes.description: Words such as more or than in a more-than-X comparison.
